edits.before: Best wave: an E-Q cleared push that crashes with Doom glowing — your shove doubles as a fear-loaded threat display. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with W down and no glow — the anti-dive mage with no anti or dive left. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.

edits.before: Trade while his setup spell is loaded. Fear-pulse his poke instead of his engage. Stand at his max range unmarked. Save the R for moments with names on them.
edits.after: Trade while her setup spell is loaded. Fear-pulse her poke instead of her engage. Stand at her max range unmarked. Save the R for moments with names on them.

edits.before: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Neeko with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish his team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.
edits.after: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Neeko with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish her team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root) is 12s at rank 1: it roots everything it passes through — minions are no cover, dodge sideways and step up on its downtime. - W Personal Space (16s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Pop Blossom is 120s: fights, not waves.

notes: cooldowns: dropped the pre-existing 'sidestep it behind minions' claim — Riot's Tangle-Barbs text says it roots everything it passes through, so minions are not cover. Replaced with the description-backed advice plus real cooldowns (E 12s, W 16s, R 120s).
